data.one_liner: Mapbox Vector Tiles support for flutter_map powered by native MapLibre SDKs.
data.what_it_does: It provides performant Mapbox Vector Tiles (MVT) support for flutter_map. It allows you to either add a MapLibre map as a layer to a FlutterMap or use FlutterMap layers inside a MapLibre map.
use_when: You need Mapbox Vector Tiles (MVT) support in your flutter_map application
You want to combine native MapLibre maps with flutter_map layers
avoid_when: You prefer pure Flutter-rendered map layers without native MapLibre SDK dependencies
strengths: Performant vector tiles support via native MapLibre SDKs
Offers bidirectional integration (MapLibre as a layer in flutter_map, or flutter_map layers inside MapLibre)
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific setup steps for the underlying maplibre package
Early version (0.0.5) with potential breaking changes
data.setup_notes: Requires adding dependencies to pubspec.yaml and following platform-specific setup steps for the maplibre package on Web, Android, and iOS.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Google Maps native SDKs instead of MapLibre vector tiles.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want standard raster tile maps without native MapLibre vector tile dependencies.
